raw_segments.text: Yago, it were a tedious difficulty, I think, to bring them to that prospect.
Damn them then if ever mortal eyes do see them bolster more than their own.
It is impossible you should see this, where they as prime as goats, as hot as monkeys,
as salt as wolves in pride, and fools as gross as ignorance made drunk.
But yet I say, if imputation and strong circumstances, which lead directly to the door of truth,
will give you satisfaction you may have.
